# EngineeringXYZ

> Mechanical engineering consultancy in Irvine, California. Takes machine
> prototypes, fixtures, inspection systems, and production equipment from
> concept — or from a stalled state — to build-ready engineering.

EngineeringXYZ helps manufacturers and hardware teams move stalled machine,
fixture, inspection, and production-equipment projects toward build-ready
engineering. Every engagement is led directly by Dr. SaiKit (Marco) Wu, Ph.D.
(mechanical engineering), supported by a trusted network of specialized
engineering professionals when a project's scope requires it. Clients keep a
single point of accountability.

Contact: mwu@engineeringxyz.com · 760-515-1517
Location: Irvine, CA. Southern California on-site; remote clients nationwide.

Note: this file describes the redesigned site while it is staged at /v3/. It
moves to the site root at go-live.

## Services

- **Machine Prototypes and Production Equipment** — concept layouts,
  mechanical architecture, 3D CAD, engineering drawings, vendor-ready
  packages, build-readiness review, commissioning support.
- **Fixture, Workholding, and Poka-Yoke Design** — fixture concepts,
  mistake-proofing features, operator-flow improvements, tolerance and
  interface review, fabrication drawings.
- **Inspection and Test Systems** — inspection positioning systems,
  test-station mechanical design, part-presentation fixtures, integration
  with existing gauges and optics.
- **Mechanical Design and Engineering Drawings** — 3D CAD modeling,
  engineering drawings with GD&T as appropriate, tolerance and interface
  review, design-for-assembly review, drawing-release support.
- **Manufacturing and Production Engineering Support** — equipment layouts,
  architecture and simplification studies, design-for-assembly review,
  vendor-ready build packages.
- **Project Recovery and Engineering Capacity** — design review and
  troubleshooting, project recovery assessments, overflow design and drawing
  work, vendor coordination, handoff packages.

## Process

Share the current problem → review technical fit → define a focused first
scope. Most engagements start with a design review, a concept package, or a
single fixture; first scopes typically run two to four weeks. No large initial
commitment is required. Confidential project information can be reviewed under
NDA. The first conversation is a technical-fit discussion — a direct read on
scope, risks, and fit — not a sales call.

## Documented outcomes

These are three specific projects, not typical results:

- A machine concept requiring 49 motors was redesigned to deliver the same
  required functions with 4 motors.
- One client scheduling workflow was reduced from about two days to about
  40 seconds.
- 10+ years of mechanical engineering and automation experience.

Two U.S. patent applications are in process (filed July 2025).

## Note on company claims

EngineeringXYZ publishes no staff-size, office-size, revenue, or certification
claims. It is presented as a consultancy led by an experienced principal
engineer, supported by a network of specialists when scope requires. Client
names and proprietary project details are withheld for confidentiality.
